scenarios.expected_behavior: Lease expiry, automatic standby quorum election, epoch increment

scenarios.expected_behavior: 100% of stale epoch writes rejected with FencingError

scenarios.expected_behavior: Immediate invalidation, zero pipeline crash, raw payload saved in quarantine

scenarios.name: Inverted Order Book: Crossed Quote
scenarios.expected_behavior: Tagged CROSSED_QUOTE, routed to quarantine table
scenarios.observed_behavior: Quarantined immediately without corrupting consolidated BBO book

scenarios.name: Upstream Packet Loss: Sequence Gap
scenarios.expected_behavior: Tagged SEQUENCE_GAP, routed to quarantine, gap alert emitted
scenarios.observed_behavior: Correctly quarantined, zero state disruption to competing feeds

scenarios.name: Slow Consumer Buffer Exhaustion
scenarios.expected_behavior: Oldest frames dropped, consumer auto-evicted after threshold, zero publisher stall
